    MagnitudeConjecture.ObjectDeletion.isAdmissible_stage

    Admissibility of the finite-cover deletion stages #

    Every intermediate stage in the ordered deletion of a deck orbit is a literal object-deletion quotient, hence remains admissible.

    CoveringHom.IsAdmissible

    Every ordered subgroup-orbit deletion stage inherits admissibility from the ambient covering category.
